name: 貝宇瀚
objective: Students will first learn about the fundamentals of signals and their transducing in various applications. The class will give an overview of different measurement systems and examine their working principles. Through exercises, students will be enabled to analyze and build basic measurements systems for data acquisition. The class is taught in English and all student assignments will be required to be in English.
schedule:
1. Course overview, Signal and measurement fundamental terms
2. Transducers
3. Sig. Proc. 1: Analog Processing
4. Sig. Proc. 2: Analog Processing 2 / Exercise + Assignment 1
5. Sig. Proc. 3: Fourier Transform / Exercise + Assignment 2
6. Sig. Proc. 4: Digital processing
7. Sig. Proc. 5: AI for digital processing / Exercise + Assignment 3
8. Meas. Systems 1: Electrical quantities
9. Meas. Systems 2: Light
10. Meas. Systems 3: Geometrical
11. Meas. Systems 4: Movement
12. Exercise + Assignment 4
13. Meas. Systems 5: Force
14. Meas. Systems 6: Flow, Chemical
15. Meas. Systems 7: Environmental
16. Final Exam
scorePolicy:
1. Active participation (e.g. respond to teacher, asking a relevant question): 10%
+ 2. Assignments 2 out of 4: 40%
+ 3. Final exam: 40%
+ 4. Flexible learning assignment: 10%
= total mark
